name: TorLink-PlusPlus
description: TorLink++ is a self-hosted Torznab + torrent-download gateway built on top of the original Torlink terminal torrent finder/downloader. The original Torlink project, its terminal TUI, curated search experience, source integrations, and downloader foundation were created by bairon / baairon. Full credit for that original work belongs to the original author. This repository is a fork that adds a LAN-friendly web layer and automation integrations around that foundation.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Host path where TorLink++ writes built-in downloader files. The container path must remain /downloads.

ports.name: Web UI / Torznab Port
ports.description: Browser Web UI and Torznab API port. Host port 19117 avoids the common Jackett conflict on 9117. Use http:// :[PORT:9117]/ for the Web UI and http:// :[PORT:9117]/api?apikey=YOUR_KEY for Radarr/Sonarr.

variables.name: Torznab API Key
variables.description: Long random API key for Radarr/Sonarr/Torznab access. You can also generate/rotate this from the trusted Web UI after install.

variables.name: Trusted Web UI
variables.description: Allows same-origin browser Web UI requests without manually entering the API key. Only enable on a trusted LAN.

variables.name: Torznab Empty Query
variables.description: Fallback broad query used when Radarr/Sonarr validates Torznab without a search term.

variables.name: qBittorrent Web UI URL
variables.description: Optional. qBittorrent Web UI URL for manual QBT button handoff, for example http://qbittorrent:8080. Radarr/Sonarr should normally use their own download-client settings.

variables.name: qBittorrent Username
variables.description: Optional qBittorrent username for manual QBT button handoff.

variables.name: qBittorrent Password
variables.description: Optional qBittorrent password or API key for manual QBT button handoff.

variables.name: qBittorrent Category
variables.description: Optional qBittorrent category for manual QBT button handoff.

variables.name: qBittorrent Save Path
variables.description: Optional qBittorrent save path override for manual QBT button handoff. Leave blank to use qBittorrent defaults.
